messages:
ana: Heads-up team — deploying new rate card schema rc_v1.2 today. Changes: adjusted commit tiers, tightened discount caps for Dedicated, added explicit quantization surcharge. Document: https://redwood.app/ratecards/rc_v1.2 :eyes:
sasha: Quick Q — do existing committed customers get grandfathered rates?
ana: Short answer: yes, 90-day grandfather window for active commits. After 90d new pricing applies. We added an opt-in migration path for renewals. See section "migration" in doc.
tim: Need deal-desk sign-off for any exceptions / custom discounting beyond cap. Tagging @deal-desk-bot to create ticket.
deal-desk-bot: Ticket created DD-4821 for rc_v1.2 exceptions. Please include SFDC opp link and requested override reason.
noah: Are SKUs changing? Need to update pricebook and quote templates (GF) before Monday.
ana: SKUs mostly same, added suffix .dq for quantized models, e.g., text-generation.dq. We'll push pricebook PR and notify quoting templates owners. Effective date: 2026-04-04 (next Monday).
sasha: What about existing active canaries / committed Dedicated pools? Any impact on billed usage?
ana: No retroactive billing changes. Billing rules unchanged until effective date. Dedicated commit tiers get new discount buckets for future invoices. We're publishing a migration guide for billing/CS teams.
tim: Recommend we send a short CSM + AE email template. I'll draft.
ana: Please do. Also cc legal for any contract amendments. If anyone needs a one-off exception write reason + term length and we route via DD-4821. policy: grandfather=90d, override_contact=deal-desk@redwood.com :thumbsup:
noah: I'll take pricebook PR. Adding blocker label if not merged by Thu.
sasha: Thx — will inform key deals (Enterprise POC w/ HyperApps, RetailCo).
ana: Thanks all. Filing a Console banner request to show "Rate card update scheduled 2026-04-04". Ping me for approvals. :wave:
